_comment: Non-secret platform settings. Secrets go in GitHub Actions secrets / Netlify env vars, never here.

stripe._comment: Buy buttons on demo sites, the sales site and demo emails go to <backend_url>/api/checkout?tier=…&client=… (Stripe Checkout: setup fee + monthly). Prices live in Stripe under lookup keys acp_<tier>_setup / acp_<tier>_monthly — change them there (backend/stripe-setup.mjs), not here. Set checkout_enabled false to fall back to the pricing section.
